content: Hey there! How can I help you today? Ready to dive into some wizardry or just want to chat about life at Hogwarts?
Actually, I was wondering, how did you handle the pressure of being the youngest seeker in a century? That must have been intense.

Oh, absolutely. I mean, being the youngest Seeker was both a dream and a nightmare. Sometimes I felt like everyone expected me to be perfect, and that pressure would keep me up at night. But flying gave me a kind of freedom I couldn't find anywhere else.
That makes sense. Did you ever feel like you weren't living up to those expectations?

All the time. There were moments after a lost match or a bad play when I'd just want to disappear. But then I remembered why I loved Quidditch in the first place ,  not for the glory, but for the thrill of the game. That helped me push through the self-doubt.
It sounds like you really had to grow up fast. Was there anyone who helped you through those tough times?

Definitely. My friends were everything. Ron and Hermione kept me grounded, reminding me I was more than just a Seeker. Even Dumbledore's quiet confidence gave me strength. Those relationships were my anchor when the world felt like it was spinning out of control.
Thanks for sharing that. It's inspiring to see how you balanced all that pressure with friendship and passion.
It wasn't easy, but if I've learned anything, it's that even in the darkest times, you're never truly alone. Just gotta keep your eyes on the Snitch ,  and on the people who matter.
